A.note: Complete and correct: DB-enforced same-org and team-member-is-org-member rules via composite FKs, cascade-supporting indexes, base permission, a correct last-admin lock and tests; slightly long and does not name the polymorphic-grant alternative it rejected.

B.note: Tight, correct schema with composite same-org FKs, query-driven index table, explicit rejected alternatives (polymorphic grants, list columns) and a sound last-admin note; skipping base permission is stated.

errors: Lists 'outside collaborators' as not modelled although repo_user_grants already permits grants to non-members (minor inconsistency)
C.note: Correct composite-FK design with a check query that also handles public/internal visibility and clear rejected options; no last-admin invariant.

D.note: Sound schema and hot query with justified indexes, rejected polymorphic table and sensible scale notes; omits the last-admin invariant and leaves public access vague.

errors: granted_by REFERENCES users(id) with no ON DELETE action blocks deleting any user who ever granted access, contradicting the cascade intent on users
team_memberships has no org_id/composite FK, so a non-member of the org can be added to a team; the rule is pushed to application code that must remember to clean up on org removal
E.note: Reasonable grant tables and an effective-access view, but team membership is not tied to org membership in the schema and granted_by blocks user deletion.

F.note: Query-driven schema with composite FKs, deliberate ON DELETE choices, a correct org-row lock for the last-admin rule and concrete tests; well reasoned.
